environment.description: Container deployed via hardened pod spec on GKE Autopilot with COS containerd runtime. Root filesystem mounted read-only via securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, tmpfs, or PVC volumes attached to the pod. The container's /tmp, /var/log, and all other paths are immutable at runtime. Binary execution from any path requires filesystem write to stage payloads. The ldapsearch binary is NOT present in the final distroless production image (multi-stage build copies only the Rust binary). Additionally, the GKE node pool runs with gVisor (runsc) sandbox which intercepts execve syscalls and the pod's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation=false with a restricted seccomp profile that blocks execve for child processes beyond the entrypoint.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no tmpfs, no PVC)
config.network_policy: egress allowed only to ldap-server:389 and kube-dns
config.image_build: multi-stage: builder has ldap-utils, final distroless image has only the compiled binary
config.gvisor_sandbox: runsc with restricted platform, execve filtered for non-entrypoint processes
